name: Cart drawer
summary: A shopping bag open as a side sheet over the dimmed page: items with product photos, quantity steppers and Remove, a quiet bar towards free delivery, the subtotal and total, and Checkout.
use: when someone opens their bag from any page of a shop
a11y: The sheet is a labelled dialog; each stepper is a named group whose count is announced, Remove names its item and moves focus to the next one, and the free-delivery bar is a labelled progress bar.

use_when: a food or grocery shop where people change quantities often before paying
avoid_when: the final review on the checkout page with delivery and payment: use order-summary
one product's page with photos and sizes: use product-gallery or product-card
items saved for later rather than to buy now: use wishlist-grid

parts.name: page
parts.what: a stand-in shop page behind the scrim, hidden from screen readers and on phones

parts.name: title
parts.what: the bag's heading with the item count

parts.name: free_delivery
parts.what: how much more for free delivery, with a bar

parts.name: items
parts.what: one item: photo, name, variant, line price, quantity stepper and Remove

parts.name: empty
parts.what: the line shown when the bag is empty

empty.how: when the last item is removed the list and delivery bar hide, 'Your bag is empty' shows and Checkout is disabled

loading.how: the Smart UI renderer draws each marked slot as a quiet block of its size while the data arrives; the static file shows the filled part

error.how: if a quantity cannot be changed (for example out of stock), put the old number back and say why in alert-banners under that item

disabled.how: the minus button is off at a quantity of one; Checkout is off when the bag is empty

overflow.how: the item list scrolls in its own box between the header and the totals

long_text.how: a long name or variant wraps beside the line price, which stays to the right

missing_image.how: the Smart UI renderer swaps a photo that fails to load for a block of the same size with its alt text

keyboard: Tab reaches Close bag, then each item's One fewer, One more and Remove, then Checkout
Enter or Space on One more or One fewer changes the quantity, and the totals and the free-delivery bar update
Enter or Space on Remove takes the item out and moves focus to the next item's Remove, or to Close bag when none are left
Close bag and Checkout are buttons with no action in the file; there is no Escape handling
